question.text: A point source of light is used in an experiment of photo-electric effects. If the distance between the source and the photo-electric surface is doubled, which of the following may result?

options.text: Maximum kinetic energy if photo-electrons will decrease

solution.text:
Hint: 
Intensity $\mathrm{I} \propto \frac{1}{\text { d }}$
and photo-electric current $\propto$ intensity
$\therefore$ Current will decrease
